cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Good morning

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Hi, this is Michelin Meyer. I’m renting your house on Archwood Avenue. I’m due to move in next week.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh, yes. Hello, Ms. Meyer. What can I do for you?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: When I viewed the house, I told you I’ll most probably need to rent some furniture, at least until I know whether my temporary work contract is going to be made permanent.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes, of course. I remember. And I said I could give you some information about furniture rental companies in the city.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: That’s right.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, the biggest company is called Peak Rentals. I’ve recommended them to other people and have always heard positive reports about them.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Could you give me an idea of their costs?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sure. I actually have one of their brochures here. It says the monthly price per room starts at $105 and goes up to $239. That depends on which rooms you need furniture for, of course.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Sure. It’s just to get a general idea of how much it’s going to cost. And you said you had some positive feedback about this company?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: People have mentioned that the furniture from Peak Rentals is more modern than any of the other companies.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And also, once you place an order, the furniture will be delivered to you in just one or two days.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: That would be really helpful.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh, and the brochure says that there’s a special offer at the moment.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that’s a set of chairs and a TV table, you’ll also get a lamp at no extra cost.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Okay, but you know, that price range you gave is more than I was hoping to pay.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Then you could try Aaron and Oliver.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Sorry, what and Oliver?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Aaron, double A-R-O-N

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: OK, are they cheaper

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I say they are a mid company But if you chose them you need to be aware that they charge an extra 12 every month in case of damage

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Oh, I see. I’d have to do the math carefully then.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Right. But one helpful thing is that they also do cleaning for customers.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: For the furniture?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: For the house.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Oh, I see. I probably won’t need that.
Now listen and answer questions 6 to 10.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: There’s another company called Larch Furniture. It’s quite new, and it has the lowest prices in town. That’s for both furniture and also electronic equipment.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Well, that would be good. I’m not bringing much with me, and I won’t have much time to go shopping after I start my job.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: There are two things you need to know about large furniture. First of all you have to take out insurance on the furniture and you need to organize that yourself

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: That wouldn’t be too hard.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Also you can take out a contract for less than six months but I figure that might not be a problem for you. You’re renting the house for 12 months after all, aren’t you?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, okay. Well, I…

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sorry to interrupt. I just thought of another furniture rental company. It’s called Space Rentals, and it’s located very near to the house.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Okay.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I don’t have any information about their charges, so it’s best to use their app to find out what it would cost you to use them.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Okay, thanks. I’ll do that.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: One good thing about that company is that if you don’t like the furniture once it’s delivered, you can request exchanges, as long as you do that within a week of receiving it.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: That sounds really great. Okay, well, thanks very much. That’s so helpful
